shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcuts

labels.aiGenerate: AI: new request from a description

shortcut.tabRangeLabel: Go to tab 1 to 9 (9 is the last tab)

labels.lists: Move through the collection tree, history and menus
labels.pages: In the collection tree, move a screen up or down
labels.folders: In the collection tree, collapse or expand a folder, or go to its parent
labels.open: Open the request in a tab, or open or close the folder
labels.jump: Jump to a request or folder by its name
labels.reorder: In the collection tree, move the request or folder up or down
labels.clipboard: In the collection tree, cut, copy or paste the request or folder
labels.duplicate: In the collection tree, duplicate the request or folder
labels.undoTree: In the collection tree, undo or redo the last move, paste or duplicate
labels.select: In the collection tree, select several items: toggle one, extend the selection, or select all. Esc clears it
labels.remove: Delete the request or folder (or all selected items), close the tab or remove the history entry
labels.menu: Show the actions for the request or folder
labels.results: Move from a search field into its results
labels.leaveEditor: Leave a code editor: press Esc, then Tab

shortcut.webNotice: In the browser, Alt replaces the shortcuts that browsers keep for themselves: Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Shift+T and Ctrl+Tab.

errors.needsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt or the command key. A function key can be used alone.
errors.needsDigit: Press a modifier together with a number key. The other tabs use the same modifier.
errors.altGraph: Ctrl and Alt together are what many keyboards send for AltGr, which types symbols. Choose another combination.
errors.metaUnsupported: The Windows or Super key cannot be used. Choose another combination.
errors.ambiguousModifiers: Command and Control together are not supported. Choose one of them.
errors.editing: This combination edits text in every field and cannot be reassigned.
errors.browser: Browsers keep this combination for themselves, so the page never receives it.
errors.system: The operating system keeps this combination for itself.
